note: ADR-0006 template-owned path boundary. Ownership is resolved by longest matching prefix; a prefix ending in '/' matches a directory subtree, otherwise it matches an exact file. On a tie, user-owned wins (fail-closed: an upgrade never touches a path it isn't sure the template owns). Conservatively excludes apps/ (portal carries user/plugin pages) and infra/environments/ (per-instance config and secrets) for now; that boundary can widen later.
